says: The transport plan's slice 2 misses two readers of door.initialize's error that AdmissionError's wrapping changes: cloudflare/runtime.ts projectStorage strips a LedgerError's cause only when the error is a bare LedgerError, so an admission LedgerError (readMembers' bad_row with its decode cause) now crosses the Durable Object RPC with its cause, and apps/fabrika's door.integration.test.ts review 3.1 expects GatewayError where AdmissionError now arrives. Neither file is in the plan's Files table, and apps/fabrika is said to be untouched. Three smaller corrections: node/ErrorCause.test.ts changes (9 lines, the suite's Harness gains a ledger field, since gateway/ may not import ledger/); AdmissionError needs the branded Schema.TaggedError form the schemaClassMissingBrand check asks for, as Routes.ts has; H1's fc.webUrl generator became Schema.URL under it.effect.prop, so its first failing case cannot match the old run.
proof: On fabrikalfa/mock-transport at the head below, CI=1 nice -n 19 pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 next/apps/fabrika/src/door.integration.test.ts -t 'review 3.1' prints 'Tests 1 failed | 152 skipped (153)' with the failure an AdmissionError; the build step reports all 153 pass without the build commit 02ce0a2f. next/packages/libfabrika/src/cloudflare/runtime.ts:512 is Effect.mapError((error) => (Schema.is(LedgerError)(error) ? new LedgerError({ reason: error.reason }) : error)), which does not match an AdmissionError.
cost: Landing slice 2 as planned leaves review 3.1 red and lets a storage cause cross the RPC that the library keeps inside today; fixing either needs a plan amendment, since both files are outside the plan.
